snippet.title: Savebot: The Last Garden – Trailer | A calm programming game, on Steam November 16
snippet.description:
Noma has fallen asleep. What is left is sand, ruins, and a Heart that still beats. Bip wakes up alone, and none of its companions knows how to do anything… yet.

You never touch the planet yourself: you teach the robots, block by block. Collect, recycle, plant, water, repair, and the block that matters most: "Repeat forever". Your robots do what you taught them, again and again, and life answers. Flowers, then trees. The rain comes back, then the sea, then the birds. Five worlds on the route of the Ark, no enemies, no villains.

Savebot: The Last Garden comes out on Steam on November 16, 2026, in English and French. Add it to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5454550/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=lancement&utm_content=bande-annonce
